summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code first (no changes made):**  I traced the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts` — and it's *cleaner* than the ticket assumes:  - Client sends `credentials: "include"` on every call, has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback for watchlist data, and no hardcoded watchlist ID. - Every watchlist route requires a valid session cookie and filters strictly by `watchlists.user_id`, including reads, writes, and ite
